archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) tailored for Fintech with Organic & Earthy undertones
emotional_tone: Trust, authority, precision, and grounded financial stability.

spacing_and_layout.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), rounded-lg, no shadow by default. Hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-sm.
spacing_and_layout.internal_padding: p-6 or p-8 for containers with borders.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align tables, dense content, and forms. Right-align monetary values in tables.

surface_strategies.header: Solid background bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/40 z-50 sticky top-0
surface_strategies.widgets: Flat solid surfaces. Avoid heavy glassmorphism for finance data to prevent visual refraction.

component_rules.buttons: rounded-md font-medium transition-all hover:bg-primary/90 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20
component_rules.tables: Shadcn UI table, text-sm, left-aligned columns, right-aligned monetary amounts. Use monospaced font for numbers.
component_rules.forms: Shadcn Form components, labels uppercase tracking-wide, input fields flat with 1px border focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary
component_rules.modals: Shadcn Dialog/Sheet, use Sheet for adding transactions (slides from right, feels more 'admin').

image_urls.description: Clean minimalist abstract topographic map lines, light mode, subtle sage green and off-white. Use as a subtle watermark background for empty states, loaders, or login hero to ground the real-estate theme.

motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for plot cards and table rows using Framer Motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum contrast. Use text-shadow if placing text over the topographic image.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-transaction-button', data-testid='plot-card-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Vite + React + Tailwind + Firebase Firestore.
Implement Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Manrope for body text. Add JetBrains Mono for all currency/number displays to ensure tabular lining.
Format all currency values as INR ₹ using toLocaleString('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }).
Layout structure: A left sidebar or top nav with Dashboard, Plots, and Settings. Main area uses the 'Control Room' dense Grid.
Plot Dashboard: Show summary widgets (Total Paid, Pending, Online Total, Cash Total) at the top. Below, a grid of Plot Cards.
Plot Cards: Must show Plot Name, Total Cost, Total Paid, Pending. Clicking opens a detailed view or side-Sheet for transactions.

Transactions: Table with Person, Bank (IDFC/SBI/AXIS/Cash), Mode (Online/Cash/UPI/ATM Withdrawal), Type (Plot Payment/Advance/Withdrawal/Registration/Documentation), Amount, Notes. Include Delete functionality.
Calculations: Plot Cost + Registration Fee = Final Total Cost. Pending = Final Total - Total Paid.
Strictly follow the color palette to maintain the 'Old Money Tech' Swiss high-contrast aesthetic. Do NOT use default Vercel or Stripe presets without customizing spacing and borders.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY form input, button, and table row for automated testing.
